import struct
MASK64=(1<<64)-1

def bit(x,i): return (x>>i)&1
pairs=[]
for line in open('pairs.txt'):
    p,c=map(int,line.split()); pairs.append((p,c))

def inv_A_B(p,c):
    L0=p>>32
    R4=c>>32
    L4=(c&MASK64)^R4
    return bit(L0,24)^bit(R4,24)^bit(L4,16)^bit(L4,26)
def inv_A2_B2(p,c):
    L0=p>>32
    R4=c>>32
    L4=(c&MASK64)^R4
    return bit(L0,16)^bit(R4,16) ^ bit(L4,10)^bit(L4,18)^bit(L4,26)
print('I1 values', [inv_A_B(p,c) for p,c in pairs])
print('I2 values', [inv_A2_B2(p,c) for p,c in pairs])
PY

import random
M=(1<<32)-1
def rot8(x,n): return ((x<<n)|(x>>(8-n)))&0xff
def g(a,b,x): return rot8((a+b+x)&0xff,2)
def F(v):
    x=[v&255,(v>>8)&255,(v>>16)&255,(v>>24)&255]
    y2=g(x[3]^x[2],x[1]^x[0],1)
    y3=g(x[3],y2,0)
    y1=g(x[1]^x[0],y2,0)
    y0=g(x[0],y1,1)
    return y0 | (y1<<8) | (y2<<16) | (y3<<24)
bad=0
for _ in range(100000):
    v=random.getrandbits(32)
    pred=((v>>0)^(v>>8)^(v>>16)^(v>>24)^1)&1
    if ((F(v)>>18)&1)!=pred: bad+=1
print('bad',bad)
